answer: An farming party therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The prism counter is kept in dune and spiral shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 9 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
